title: [Chapitre] VII. Analysis situs (troisième mouture) : notes manuscrites (23-26/06/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context. In the 1986 'Analysis situs' notes Grothendieck is trying to axiomatize, purely combinatorially, the structure carried by a family of 'pieces' (strata, multistrata, polyhedra) of a tame space. The previous page introduces a structure (M, ≤, ≪, ≭), which he proposes to call an 'algèbre de strates' or 'algèbre de multistrates':
- M is a set of objects.
- X ≤ Y means X is a sub-piece of Y.
- X ≪ Y means X lies in the 'ombre' (shadow, roughly the closure) of Y. Omb(Y) is the set of X with X ≪ Y.
- X ∘≪ Y is the 'interior' version: X lies in the interior part Omb(Y)° of the shadow, as a point lies in the open cell of its carrier.
- ≭ is a compatibility (non-disjointness) relation.

Top of page. One such structure can be realized by several families F ⊂ P(M). Among them there is a largest one: all subsets of M that are closed under ≤ and consist of pairwise ≭-compatible elements. These subsets play the role of the realizable spaces or sub-complexes.

Grothendieck then gives three ways to axiomatize. Two are on this page; the third is on p.52.

(1) Translate his earlier axioms At1–At7 'sans plus' (dropping those about f) into 'practical' axioms Prat 1–6. His margin titles are given in parentheses.
- Prat1: X ≤ Y ⇒ X ≪ Y.
- Prat2 (transitivity of the interior relation): X ∘≪ Y and Y ∘≪ Z ⇒ X ∘≪ Z.
- Prat3 (existence of a minimal carrier): if X ≪ Y, then there is Y' ≤ Y with X ∘≪ Y'. So Omb(Y) is the union of the interiors of the shadows of the pieces of Y, i.e. the shadow is stratified by the pieces.
- Compatibility axiom: ≭ is reflexive and symmetric, and inherited downward (X' ≤ X, Y' ≤ Y, X ≭ Y ⇒ X' ≭ Y').
- Prat4 (uniqueness of the minimal carrier): X ∘≪ Y, X ∘≪ Y', Y ≭ Y' ⇒ Y = Y'.
- Prat6 (comparison of ≪ and ≤ for compatible objects): if X ≭ Y, then X ≪ Y ⇒ X ≤ Y.
These are the axioms of an abstract cell or stratified complex: each element lies in the open part of a unique carrier among mutually compatible pieces, and closure-incidence among compatible pieces is just the face order.

(2) The same translation, relativized to a dense subset Λ ⊂ M. Dense means every X has some Z ∈ Λ with Z ∘≪ X, i.e. omb_Λ(X)° ≠ ∅. Λ plays the role of 'test points' or minimal objects.
- PratΛ1: X ≤ Y ⇒ X ≪ Y.
- PratΛ2: density of Λ.
- PratΛ3 (minimal objects for Z ∈ Λ): if Z ∈ Λ and Z ≪ X, then Z ∘≪ X' for some X' ≤ X.
- PratΛ4 (axiom of the induced relation): for Y ≤ X ≥ X' and Z ∈ Λ with Z ≪ Y and Z ≪ X', there is Y' ≤ Y with Y' ≪ X' and Z ≪ Y'. If Y ≤ X one may take Y' ≤ X'. Equivalently omb_Λ(Y) ∩ omb_Λ(X') = omb_Λ(Y_{X'}), where Y_{X'} = Ỹ ∩ Omb(X').
- Compatibility axiom (numbered Λ5): reflexive, symmetric, hereditary.
- PratΛ5: if X ≭ Y, then omb_Λ(X) ∩ omb_Λ(Y) = omb_Λ(X̃ ∩ Ỹ). The tilde denotes the set of pieces ≤ X. So shadows of compatible objects meet exactly along the shadow of their common pieces.
Margin claim: for Λ = M this system is equivalent to system (1); density is then vacuous.

On p.52 the third conception takes Λ = L, the set of ≪-minimal elements ('points'). There ≭ is replaced by a disjunction relation ∥ on L, giving 'spacious' and 'polyhedral' structures.

Purpose. The aim is a finitary, order-theoretic ('algebraic') presentation of stratified or polyhedral tame spaces, in which the space is recovered from the incidence algebra of its pieces.
errors: PratΛ5 as written reads '∃ Z' ∈ M avec Z' ≪ Z ≤ X,Y'. This contradicts its own bracketed reformulation omb_Λ(X) ∩ omb_Λ(Y) = omb_Λ(X̃ ∩ Ỹ), which needs Z ≪ Z' ≤ X, Y. This is a slip in the relation order.
Numbering is inconsistent: Prat 4 was first numbered 5, and there is no Prat 5. In version (2) two axioms are labelled 'Prat Λ 5', and Prat Λ 4 is added afterwards (arrow) below the NB.

The margin claim that system (2) with Λ = M is equivalent to system (1) is not obvious and is not proved. System (2) has no transitivity of ∘≪ (Prat2) and no uniqueness-of-carrier axiom (Prat4) as such. It also needs ∘≪ to be reflexive for density to be vacuous. The equivalence presumably relies on the semantics of At1–At7 rather than a formal derivation.
In the NB after (1), 'deux' is corrected to 'trois' dernières axiomes. This count is correct only if the unnumbered compatibility axiom counts as one of them.

ideas.what: Algebraic structure (M, ≤, ≪, ≭), called 'algèbre de (multi)strates', encoding a stratified or polyhedral space through face order, closure-incidence (shadow) and compatibility of pieces
ideas.modern_name: abstract cell/stratified complexes; face posets of regular CW or stratified spaces; exit-path poset combinatorics
ideas.usually_credited_to: Tucker (1933) abstract cell complexes; Steinitz; later Kovalevsky (digital topology); posets of strata in stratification theory (Thom–Mather)
ideas.where_published: Tame topology programme announced in Esquisse d'un programme (1984), without such axioms

ideas.what: Existence and uniqueness of the minimal carrier (Prat3, Prat4): every element lies in the interior of exactly one piece among pairwise compatible pieces
ideas.modern_name: carrier/support of a point in a cell complex; open star decomposition

ideas.what: Relativization to a dense subset Λ of test objects, with shadow intersection axioms omb_Λ(X) ∩ omb_Λ(Y) = omb_Λ(X̃ ∩ Ỹ)
ideas.modern_name: dense basis / point-separating subset; meet-preservation of shadows (cf. bases of continuous posets, contact algebras with dense subalgebras)
ideas.usually_credited_to: unsure; analogues in domain theory (Scott, Gierz et al. 1980) and region-based topology (de Vries 1962; Düntsch–Vakarelov 2000s)

ideas.what: Largest realization: the family of ≤-closed subsets of pairwise compatible elements
ideas.modern_name: flag/clique-type complex of compatible elements; down-closed cliques

missed.claim: Grothendieck's point-free axiomatization of space uses a 'well-inside/shadow' relation ≪ beside ≤, a compatibility or disjunction relation, interpolation axioms (p.50) and dense subsets. This closely parallels region-based or point-free topology: de Vries compingent algebras with interpolation (1962), proximity/contact algebras (Efremovich, Düntsch–Vakarelov) and the Region Connection Calculus. That literature developed independently and never cites these notes; conversely, his tame/polyhedral motivation is absent there.
missed.quote: Il y a lieu de considérer (M, ≤, ≪, ≭) comme une structure algébrique indépendante ... 'algèbre de strates'
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It could give a contact-algebra-style duality for stratified or polyhedral (o-minimal) spaces, which current region-based topology does not treat.

missed.claim: The comparison between the three axiom systems is left unproved. This covers the claimed equivalence of (1) and (2) for Λ = M and the role of the disjunction version on p.52. So is any realization theorem: which algebras of strata come from actual stratified or polyhedral spaces.
missed.quote: NB. Le syst. d'axiomes est équivalent au précédent pour Λ = M
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: A representation theorem for such 'strata algebras' would be a combinatorial foundation for tame topology. Nothing of this specific form seems to be in the literature.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but provisional axiom bookkeeping page. The individual axioms are elementary cell-complex facts. The interest lies in the unpublished programme of an algebraic, point-free axiomatization of tame stratified spaces and its unnoticed kinship with de Vries/contact-algebra point-free topology.
transcription_corrections: The compatibility symbol is ≭ (not-asymp), as on p.50, not '∯/between'.
Prat Λ 4 first line: 'Soient Y ≤ X ≥ X'' (X' written under X with ≤ turned upward, i.e. X' ≤ X), not 'Y ≤ X {+X'+}'.
Prat Λ 4 bracket: Y_{X'} := Ỹ ∩ Omb(X') (tilde over Y, i.e. the pieces of Y), consistent with p.52.
Prat Λ 5 bracket: L = X̃ ∩ Ỹ, with tildes.
'OPS' in Prat Λ 4 means 'on peut supposer': if Y ≤ X one may suppose Y' ≤ X'.
The page reference after 'cf' is probably 'p. 6' with a struck-out digit; '62' is doubtful.
The bottom-left margin probably reads approximately 'NB On peut blinder Prat Λ3, Λ4 en exigeant ∀ Z ≪ X (pas seulement Z ∈ Λ)'. It is not a separate claim.
